verdict.rationale: Docusign's docs show generic 'reusable templates' and template-sharing features for agreements you build yourself, but there is no evidence of a curated library of pre-vetted legal templates (NDAs, standard agreements, policies) that a founder could use instead of hiring counsel. Missing for 10: evidence of an actual vetted template library/marketplace, legal review or certification of template content, and any documentation of NDA/policy-specific templates.
